content: The FIDELITY pooled analysis integrated data from the FIGARO-DKD and FIDELIO-DKD clinical trials, encompassing a total of 13,171 patients. This comprehensive analysis provided robust evidence supporting the efficacy of finerenone in reducing the risk of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, and hospitalizations due to heart failure. Finerenone demonstrated a 14% reduction in the primary composite outcome, which included cardiovascular death and major adverse kidney events. Regarding renal outcomes, finerenone significantly reduced the risk of sustained decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) by ≥57% and effectively slowed the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD).
